mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm31_role_desc ( tdm31_role_desc_id, tdm31_company_id, tdm31_reg_date, tdm31_reason_cd, tdm31_person_id , tdm31_role_allc_id, tdm31_allc_std_date, tdm31_upd_nm, tdm31_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{roleDescId}, #{companyId}, #{regDate}, #{reasonCode}, #{personId} , #{roleAllcId}, #{allcStdDate}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm31_role_desc WHERE tdm31_role_desc_id = #{roleDescId} AND (tdm31_work_date IS NOT NULL AND f_sysdate() BETWEEN tdm31_work_date - INTERVAL '1 minute' AND tdm31_work_date + INTERVAL '1 minute')

SELECT tdm30_role_allc_id AS role_allc_id, tdm30_person_id AS person_id, tdm30_person_nm AS person_name, tdm30_role_nm AS role_name, tdm30_add_title AS add_title, TO_CHAR(tdm30_allc_std_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS allc_std_date FROM ( SELECT tdm30.* , tdm01_person_nm AS tdm30_person_nm , tdm20_role_nm AS tdm30_role_nm , f_get_tdmPersonInfo(tdm30_person_id, #{stdDate}, '1') AS tdm30_add_title , ( SELECT MAX(tdm30_role_allc_date) FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}, true) a WHERE a.tdm30_person_id = tdm30.tdm30_person_id ) AS tdm30_allc_std_date FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}, true) tdm30 INNER JOIN tdm01_hr ON tdm01_person_id = tdm30_person_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm30_role_id WHERE 1=1 AND COALESCE(tdm30_add_title_yn,'false') = 'false' ) t WHERE CONCAT(tdm30_person_nm, tdm30_role_nm, tdm30_add_title) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm30_person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm30_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm30_allc_std_date
